summary: Familiars unlock on Day 3 and grant percentage stat carries to all heroes via the War Room. Choosing the right familiar depends on team synergies: Lava Batwing excels in Enlightenment teams, Golden Tressym powers AoE setups, and Long-Eared Deer or Hellfire Retainer dominate PvP. Fusion allows pets to gain talent slots up to 6, utilizing a 3,000-point pity system for guaranteed talent additions. Maxed 6-talent familiars can be awakened and refined with Refinement Sand to further enhance active talents.

heroes.name: Zhorak

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Benefits from Enlightenment damage talents like Loyal Follower on PvP familiars.

heroes.name: Severio
heroes.note: Scales effectively with Enlightenment boosts provided by Lava Batwing or Long-Eared Deer.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Gains significant damage bonuses from Enlightenment talent synergies in PvP.

teams.note: Lava Batwing provides Attack and Enlightenment boosts up to 15% to the highest Enlightenment ally.
Golden Tressym applies Distraction debuff, increasing AoE damage taken by enemies by 12%.
Creates damage-absorbing barriers that knock back or stun enemies upon breaking.
Revives defeated allies with 100% HP and 100% ultimate energy every 30 seconds.

meta_changes: Introduction of Familiar Awakening system requiring 6-talent familiars to generate Awakening Stones.
Addition of Hellfire Retainer as an S-tier PvP familiar featuring team resurrection mechanics.
tips: Build fusion pity to 3,000 points using redundant food pets before fusing with a pet that has a specific high-value talent.
Always save refinement results before locking slots, as locking without saving overwrites active talent refinements.
Buy Familiar Domestication Chests in the Familiar Shop to acquire guaranteed Mythic or Legendary talent scrolls each season.
